schema.title: Create a Privacy Forms Studio site
schema.description: Adds a new Plone content management system site with the Privacy Forms Studio / SurveyJS add-on installed to the underlying application server.

site_id.title: Path Identifier
site_id.description: The ID of the site. No special characters or spaces are allowed. This ends up as part of the URL unless hidden by an upstream web server.

title.title: Title
title.description: A short title for the site. This will be shown as part of the title of the browser window on each page.

setup_content.title: Create Example Content
setup_content.description: Should example content be added during site creation? This installs the demo profile: the SurveyJS themes and the demo-forms folder with three example forms.
